writeup: Woot has the new Marucci Asura -11 fastpitch softball bat in the 28-inch, 17-ounce size (MFPAS11-28/17) for $149.99. SPC Sports and Smash It Sports both list this exact size at $299.95, so it's about half the going price. It's a two-piece composite bat with Marucci's Gap Sync barrel, and Woot showed only one left with a limit of three per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Checker verified ASIN B0F3RPMQXS is the Asura -11 28in/17oz, MFPAS11-28/17, UPC 840390559616.
